description.content: Deskpin has a brand-new icon — "Aperture Pin": a diamond aperture with a centered pin on a blurple squircle. It's distinctive, reads cleanly at every size, and replaces the old monitor glyph everywhere — taskbar, window, installer shortcuts and the in-app title bar.
The icon is rebuilt with crisp per-size renders (16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256px), so it stays sharp on the taskbar and in Explorer instead of being downscaled from a single image.
No functional changes — this is a visual refresh on top of 1.3.0's SFTP file transfers.
